FUNCTION lcs(X, Y):
  m = length(X), n = length(Y)
  L = matrix of size (m+1, n+1) filled with 0
  FOR i from 1 to m:
    FOR j from 1 to n:
      IF X[i-1] == Y[j-1] THEN L[i][j] = L[i-1][j-1] + 1
      ELSE L[i][j] = max(L[i-1][j], L[i][j-1])
  RETURN L[m][n]
